## TemplateEngine.\_processMediaBlocks() method

Extracts and parses `<media>` blocks from a template string.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _processMediaBlocks(template: string): {
        [lang: string]: IMediaBlock;
    };
```

**Returns:**

{ \[lang: string\]: [IMediaBlock](./gramstax.imediablock.md)<!-- -->; }

An object mapping language keys to their corresponding media block configurations

## Remarks

This internal method identifies all `<media>` blocks and extracts their attributes and content. It supports various media types including photo, video, audio, document, animation, voice, video\_note, sticker, location, and contact. The inner content becomes the caption for supported types.

## Example


```typescript
const template = '<media type="photo" src="image.jpg" lang="en">Hello</media>';
const media = TemplateEngine._processMediaBlocks(template);
// Result: { en: { type: 'photo', src: 'image.jpg', caption: 'Hello' } }
```
